instance_description:
Setting: Pinecrest Regional Medical Center operates an accredited continuing-education office in Columbus, coordinating clinical staff learning programs throughout 2026.
Scope: Scenarios may cover session planning, speaker paperwork, attendance tracking, credit documentation, room and AV coordination, evaluation follow-up, accreditation file preparation, vendor communication, and internal updates.
Resources: Reusable structure includes staff profile records, education activity registers, professional contacts, and blank text files for agendas, disclosure checks, and credit notes.
Exclusions: The Instance excludes patient care, medical advice, payroll, school coursework, household management, personal finance, contract signing, and any scenario-specific facts before later initialization.
personal_description:
Identity: Elodie Renata March is the continuing-education program coordinator at Pinecrest Regional Medical Center, based in the medical education office near the main auditorium.
Responsibilities: She organizes accredited learning activities, maintains documentation checklists, coordinates speakers and facilities, tracks attendance materials, prepares evaluation summaries, and supports accreditation reporting.
Authority: Elodie may update internal education records, draft professional communications, schedule routine meetings, request forms, prepare approved expense documentation, and assemble compliance packets.
Restrictions: She cannot grant clinical privileges, approve medical content independently, sign vendor contracts, alter accreditation rules, manage payroll, disclose protected health information, or commit unapproved spending.
